meta.name: hypothesis-validator
meta.description: Convert a design choice, architecture option, market assumption, or feature bet into a falsifiable hypothesis with a measurable kill criterion, the cheapest useful test to settle it, and a clear record of what was supported, disproved, or deferred. Use whenever the agent is tempted to commit to a stack, a pattern, a vendor, a model, a UX flow, or a scope without evidence, and as the core supporting skill for ai-pdlc and architecture-review.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把设计或架构选择变成可证伪的假设,用最小测试验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在拍板技术或产品方向前想先验证关键假设
copy.tagline_en: Turn design or architecture bets into falsifiable tests with kill criteria.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need evidence before committing to a tech or product choice.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 不会再把没验证的看法当决定。它会把技术栈、模型、功能范围等背后的每个主张写成“假设卡”,要求先给出可证明其错误的淘汰标准,再选最便宜的验证去检验,记录支持、证伪或推迟;没有淘汰标准就不通过,单一样本不判支持。
howto.when: 当 Claude 准备在没有证据的情况下敲定技术栈、模型或功能范围等时介入,要求先验证;它也是 ai-pdlc 和架构评审等流程的核心支撑。

say.text: 帮我验证一下:选 React 当这个项目的前端框架,淘汰标准是什么?
say.note: 它会把选型写成假设卡,定出可测量的淘汰标准。

say.text: 这次架构评审里,把所有没证据的主张都列出来,写成假设卡。
say.note: 它会逐条列出并排序,先验证风险最高的。

say.text: 这个用户行为假设怎么验证?给出最便宜的测试方案。
say.note: 它会从测试清单里挑最便宜有用的一个。

howto.what_en: Unsupported claims are not treated as decisions; each claim becomes a hypothesis card with a measurable kill criterion, a cheapest useful test, and a recorded outcome (supported, disproved, or deferred).
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude is about to commit to a stack, model, or scope without evidence; also used as core support in ai-pdlc and architecture-review.

say_en.text: Validate choosing React as our frontend framework: what would disprove it?
say_en.note: Writes it as a hypothesis card with a kill criterion.

say_en.text: List every unproven claim in this architecture review as a hypothesis card.
say_en.note: It lists them and ranks the riskiest to test first.

say_en.text: How do we verify this user-behavior assumption? Give the cheapest useful test.
say_en.note: It picks the cheapest useful test for that assumption.
